figurative_meaning_en: dancing style or posture, prancing or frolicking about
example_sentences_in_bangla: ধিঙ্গী মেয়েটি ধিনধিন করে নাচতে নাচতে ঘুরে বেড়াচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The naughty girl is prancing around while dancing.
The children are frolicking about at the festival.
note: This idiom is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali folklore and everyday speech to describe lively, rhythmic movements.
